thread:
Leah M.: Quick planning thread for Urban Hub Dev Night (Fri). Small booths, high foot traffic. Need final swag plan, speaker slot confirmation, and webinar funnel.
Carlos V.: Booth is 6ft island E2. Arrival window 05:45-06:30.
Aisha R.: Current swag on hand: 140 sticker sheets, 60 enamel pins, 35 hoodies, 40 microfiber towels.
Leah M.: Hoodies running low. If hoodies <50, prioritize raffle. We need something to hand out immediately (low friction).
Maya K.: Suggest: hand out sticker sheet + pin to everyone who signs up. Hold hoodies for 1-in-10 signups raffle. Towels as backup premium.
Carlos V.: Ops update: Sam will confirm truck & manifest. Sam?
Sam (ops-bot): Manifest created. Truck: #12, Driver: Priya R., Dock: South-1, ETA: 05:50. Added 2x table, 1x pop banner, AV bag.
Devon T.: Lead capture: QR -> short HubSpot form. Fields: name, email, role, interest_tags. Hidden: utm_source=urbanhub_booth. Immediately trigger: thank-you modal with webinar invite.
Aisha R.: Webinar: 30-min "Production inference: tips and tradeoffs" Tue following week. Auto-invite booth signups, plus a special "benchmark teaser" in the webinar.
Leah M.: Who writes the teaser? Research should produce one short stat + single-slide graphic. Need it in 48h.
Maya K.: Messaging test: A/B subject lines for booth follow-up. A: "Thanks for stopping by — webinar invite" B: "How we cut inference costs in production". Track opens & clicks.
Carlos V.: Signage copy for table: short CTA "Scan to get stickers + webinar invite"; include QR large, small URL rwd.in/urbanhub.
Devon T.: Routing: if interest_tags contains "benchmark" or "cost" -> tag MQL and assign to Carlos. Else -> SDR queue. Use workflow to enroll webinar registrants into drip.
Sam (ops-bot): AV checklist added: spare HDMI->USB-C adapter x2, clicker, battery pack.
Aisha R.: Contingency for hoodie shortage: print "hoodie coupon" cards redeemable in our swag store, given to demo-bookers.
Leah M.: Social plan: Quick post 30m after teardown: "Thanks #UrbanHubDev 10 great chats about serving LLMs. Missed us? Watch the webinar: rwd.in/urbanhub/webinar" Schedule with image of booth.
Maya K.: Photo assignment: Devon will take pics; capture close-up of sign with QR and crowd shots.
Carlos V.: Action items: Sam confirm truck & manifest (today), Devon build HubSpot form + set utm (EOD), Aisha prep sticker+pin packs & coupon cards, Maya draft social copy and schedule, Leah coordinate research for benchmark teaser (48h).
Leah M.: One-liner for booth sign: "Same API. Better economics. Live demo 3pm." Keep it punchy.
Devon T.: Also adding short SMS opt-in on thank-you modal (optional). Legal copy: "By providing your number you agree to receive messages from Redwood." Keep minimal.
Aisha R.: Anything else re: speaking slot? Confirmed: Maya on panel at 2:00pm. Bring slides and 1 slide for webinar CTA.
Leah M.: Great. Reconvene tomorrow 09:30 for final checks. :rocket:
